name: envelope_validation_v1_skillcorner
question: do kinematic envelopes contain real defender positions and reject implausible ones (v1 vs pre-registered v2)?
rows: response_validation rows with a complete 1.5 s trajectory

noise.method: near-stationary players: 1.0 s centred window, line speed < 0.3 m/s; per-axis RMS residual (sigma_p) and causal-velocity deviation from the line slope (sigma_v)

v2_template.describe: envelope v2: no reaction delay, <= 7.0 m/s^2 braking or turning, speeding up <= 7(1 - v/9) m/s^2, <= 9.0 m/s, 0.10 s velocity lag
